quiz.question: What does the word 'abhor' mean?
options: To fall asleep because something is super boring.

quiz.question: What does the word 'elicit' mean?
options: A beast with an elephant head on a smaller elephant's body.

quiz.question_short: A factor of the sum of 15 + 45?

options: To get a question wrong in a quiz.

options: Spitting everywhere like a camel. In short, not cool.

quiz.question: What does the word 'hackneyed' mean?

quiz.question: What does the word 'iconoclast' mean?

One who is really good with a computer.

quiz.question: Let's settle up the bill, shall we?
options: You didn't think all this equipment was free, did you?

question_options.question: How would you rate this episode?
How did you do on the clay shooting game?
options: I hit some, I missed some.

question_options.question: Which do you enjoy more, playing as Paige or playing as Owen?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You ride on horses, you hit the ball with the mallet. Simple enough.

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Well what about the name for `two` periods of the match? Someone who's played as much polo as you claim can--
nodes.text_bbcode: Well what about the name for [color=#e23b3b][i]two[/i][/color] periods of the match? Someone who's played as much polo as you claim can--

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Chukkas? You're talking about the two chukkas, right?

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Why... You... You `have` played! I'm quite surprised!
nodes.text_bbcode: Why... You... You [color=#e23b3b][i]have[/i][/color] played! I'm quite surprised!

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You'll find I'm full of surprises. Come on, Horse!

nodes.speaker: Horse
nodes.text: Frrrrrpt!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Just had to be vocal right then, didn't you?
As the match progresses, Owen uses his athletic ability and mild horsemanship to prove somewhat competent.
At the end of the first chukka, the men rest on the sidelines, drinking sparkling waters.

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Not bad, Owen. Not bad at all.

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: But we still need to bring our A game in the second chukka to win this thing!

nodes.speaker: Rich Lady
nodes.text: Well, all in all, it sounds like he's a lovely gentleman!

nodes.speaker: Rich Lady
nodes.text: I concur!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I can't believe that worked!
Margot jumps in.

nodes.speaker: Rich Lady
nodes.text: Well, I don't know how I feel about this... This ruffian your daughter is dating, Margot!

nodes.speaker: Rich Lady
nodes.text: Are you actually permitting this?!

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Paige is on a certain kind of probation regarding her boyfriend.
Paige starts to protest, but a look from her mother stops her.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: He went to the florist and bought me this really beautiful flower!

nodes.speaker: Rich Lady
nodes.text: Was the flower made out of solid gold? I've always wanted a man to buy one of those for me...

nodes.speaker: Rich Lady
nodes.text: And to carry it around of course!

nodes.speaker: Rich Lady
nodes.text: It was probably encrusted in diamonds!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: No, it was actually just a flower...
The ladies grow silent...

nodes.speaker: Rich Lady
nodes.text: Well, if it didn't cost much, why did it matter?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I... I don't know. It was a dumb story...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: He bought me...

nodes.speaker: Rich Lady
nodes.text: A necklace?!

nodes.speaker: Rich Lady
nodes.text: A horse?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: A garden of roses!

nodes.speaker: Rich Lady
nodes.text: An entire garden?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yes... He said that to give me just one flower would be like, 'giving a queen just one subject to rule over.'
The ladies sigh.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Nailed it!

nodes.speaker: Rich Lady
nodes.text: Ah! Young romance! I miss it so! Give us something to make us feel young again!

nodes.speaker: Rich Lady
nodes.text: Yes! Share some tidbit from your first date, won't you? Something romantic?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ugh. Owen had like five dollars in his wallet. He got me, like, one flower.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Sure. I'll share something...

nodes.speaker: Rich Lady
nodes.text: House? Are you saying he lives in a simple house?

nodes.speaker: Rich Lady
nodes.text: That would explain the rough look!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Whoops! I should have tried to spin that differently!

nodes.speaker: Rich Lady
nodes.text: I guess love doesn't require `inordinate` amounts of wealth! Only some!
nodes.text_bbcode: I guess love doesn't require [color=#3b78e2][i]inordinate[/i][/color] amounts of wealth! Only some!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I can honestly say that its size is equal to its magnificence!

nodes.speaker: Rich Lady
nodes.text: Oh my!

nodes.speaker: Rich Lady
nodes.text: We must have been mistaken about our first impression.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: That's why we have second impressions!

nodes.speaker: Rich Lady
nodes.text: The what, dear?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Sorry... The... House.

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Owen's family is in the sports industry. His father's a football executive.
The ladies nod.

nodes.speaker: Rich Lady
nodes.text: Interesting. Where does Owen reside?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: He takes care of his grandmother.

nodes.speaker: Rich Lady
nodes.text: Oh, that's quite lovely. You've seen the estate?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ha!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Uh... I mean, yes, I've been to the...

nodes.speaker: Rich Lady
nodes.text: Why, that's cute!

nodes.speaker: Rich Lady
nodes.text: I remember meeting my Winston at The Alexander Preparatory School for Young Minds. It was at an ice cream social!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Meeting Owen was... Just like that.

nodes.speaker: Rich Lady
nodes.text: Delightful!

nodes.speaker: Rich Lady
nodes.text: But of course, my Winston doesn't have such a... Rough look to him like your Owen does...

nodes.speaker: Rich Lady
nodes.text: Oh dear. You went to a public school?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It's not as bad as you think.

nodes.speaker: Rich Lady
nodes.text: I'm surprised you're alive!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Why did I mention that the school was 'public'?!

nodes.speaker: Rich Lady
nodes.text: The boy... He had a... Rough look to him, similar to Margot's masseuse...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Uh... We met at, um...

nodes.speaker: Rich Lady
nodes.text: You don't remember?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Of course I remember. We met at a public school.

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: What's going on over there?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh...
Conrad steps in between them smoothly.

nodes.speaker: Conrad
nodes.text: Nothing to worry about, sir. I lost a bet about who'd be the first to score in the first chukka.
Conrad turns back to Owen.

nodes.speaker: Conrad
nodes.text: I'll take care of this. What's a few hundred between friends?
Conrad pulls a couple more bills off his stack and gives them to Owen's handler.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Thanks. I'll pay you back later, I promise.
Conrad nods, a curious look on his face.
As Tad talks with some of the other men, Conrad stops Owen.

nodes.speaker: Conrad
nodes.text: You've never played polo before, have you?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What? Of course I have! I know all about mallets and chukkas.

nodes.speaker: Conrad
nodes.text: You could have looked all that up on the internet.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: How dare you accuse me?!

nodes.speaker: Conrad
nodes.text: You're not who you claim you are. I've suspected it since you called me 'man', but I've known it since just now.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Here you are...
The handler sees Owen's empty, upturned pocket and nods with unexpected compassion.
Owen starts patting down his clothes.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Oh... You know what? I... I seem to have misplaced my money... Thingie.
The handler gives Owen a hard look and holds out his hand more insistently.

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: And I don't have time for these ridiculous stories, especially if you can't get them right!

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: We should focus on the match!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Guess I blew that...
The guys slowly return to their horses for the second chukka and put up a dismal performance...
After the match, the handlers of the grounds help Owen, Conrad, and Tad off of their horses.
Tad pulls out a credit card and hands it to his handler.

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: I'm feeling generous! Add a 4% tip for yourself!
Conrad pulls out a money clip bulging with cash. The bills seem to all be hundreds. He pulls out several bills and hands them over.
Owen catches a look from his handler.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I only have like twenty dollars in my pocket! That's probably not nearly enough to pay for all this!

options.label: Give the handler the twenty dollars.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So, there I am--

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: A personal matter?! Do you often share your personal life with your servants?

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: ...Or worse, let your servants share their personal lives with you?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh, well, actually, see, in this case...

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Never mind! I don't even care!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I flagged down the nearest, reliable-looking person and paid them to drive me home.

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Ha! If the price is right, am I right?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: And the person I hired is still my driver.

nodes.speaker: Conrad
nodes.text: Good story.

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Well, that lifted my spirits! There's always someone low enough to work for you!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm glad you enjoyed it...
The guys go out and play excellently together in the second chukka, buoyed by Owen's story!

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: You... You drove home yourself?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yup! It was nothing really. I know my way around--
Tad makes a disgusted noise.

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: How dreadful! I thought you said this story was funny!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, it is, see, I drove myself home, so--

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: I don't find stories where the fortunate are reduced to manual labor amusing!

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Perhaps `you` do!
nodes.text_bbcode: Perhaps [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] do!

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Which was?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh... To drive myself home!

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: It's `always` money for those who have none!
nodes.text_bbcode: It's [color=#e23b3b][i]always[/i][/color] money for those who have none!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: And it seems to be the only thing that matters for those who do...

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Excuse me?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Nothing. I was just agreeing with you.

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: I see...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Anyway, there I am, stuck in a towncar in the middle of nowhere!

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Terrifying!

nodes.speaker: Conrad
nodes.text: What'd you do?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: The only thing I could...

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Was what?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh... A personal matter...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: And my driver pulled over to the side of the road and quit! Right there! On the spot!

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: You have a driver?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Of course!

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Well... Ahem... Reliable help is harder and harder to find these days!

nodes.speaker: Conrad
nodes.text: What was the matter concerning?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: The matter at hand was...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: My driver pulled over to the--

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: What car did you say you were in?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: My... Cartown?

nodes.speaker: Conrad
nodes.text: He means 'towncar'.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Oh, yeah, towncar.

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: I don't care!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh, in my... Cartown? Anyway...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You ride on donkeys, you hit the ball with the, uh, polo stick. What more is there?

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: If you don't mind entertaining me further, what do you call the two periods?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You mean the upchukkas? Didn't think I knew that, did you?
Conrad shakes his head.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Did I get something wrong?

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: All of it!
Tad proceeds to explain all of the rules of polo to Owen...

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: In the `chukkas,` you ride a `horse`, and you hit the ball with a `mallet!`
nodes.text_bbcode: In the [color=#e23b3b][i]chukkas,[/i][/color] you ride a [color=#e23b3b][i]horse[/i][/color], and you hit the ball with a [color=#e23b3b][i]mallet![/i][/color]

nodes.text: By the time he's finished explaining the rules, Owen's confidence is shot!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Pretty sure I'm one slip up from completely blowing it with Tad...
At the end of the first chukka, the men rest on the sidelines, drinking sparkling waters.

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: We're going to lose this game! I'm sure of it!
By now, a small crowd of Margot's friends have gathered, many of them dignified ladies of high society.
Tad clears his throat.

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Guests, thank you all for coming! Now that you're here, I would like to announce a devious plan that Margot and I cooked up yesterday!

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: We're going to split you up! Ladies will have one agenda, and we gentlemen will have our own!
Tad throws an arm around Conrad.

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: It'll give me a chance to get to know young Conrad here. Paige says you're quite the gentleman!

nodes.speaker: Conrad
nodes.text: `And` a scholar.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]And[/i][/color] a scholar.

nodes.text: Tad shoots Owen a wicked glare through the crowd.

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: And it will also give me a chance to separate the wealthy men from the austere boys!
The crowd laughs, oblivious.

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: We'll reconvene at the house for the wedding rehearsal followed by the rehearsal dinner.
The two groups begin separating...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm dead, Paige. It's over. I can't pretend to be rich in front of Tad all day without you.
Paige grabs Owen by the arm and pulls him aside!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You `can` do it, and you're `going` to do it! And do you know why?
nodes.text_bbcode: You [color=#3b78e2][i]can[/i][/color] do it, and you're [color=#3b78e2][i]going[/i][/color] to do it! And do you know why?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No, why?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Because if you don't, if you mess this up, if I end up at another maximum security prison posing as a prep school...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I swear! I `swear!` I will `ruin` your life! Got it?
nodes.text_bbcode: I swear! I [color=#3b78e2][i]swear![/i][/color] I will [color=#3b78e2][i]ruin[/i][/color] your life! Got it?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I got it, I got it! No pressure or anything...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Good.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You know, you gave me goosebumps just now.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What does that mean? Is that a thing beggars say? Are you sick?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No, I'm not sick... It's... How do you not know that phrase?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Never mind! Just focus, and don't throw up!
Paige leaves Owen and begins mingling with the crowd of ladies. Owen turns and heads toward the guy group, toward Conrad and Tad...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: If only the silent treatment could be used to `impress` snobs...
nodes.text_bbcode: If only the silent treatment could be used to [color=#e23b3b][i]impress[/i][/color] snobs...

nodes.text: You are now playing as Owen.
On the polo field, Owen sits atop a strong black stallion.

nodes.speaker: Horse
nodes.text: Frrrrrpt!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That's... An unusual noise... I hope you're not broken, Horse.
Across the field, some of the husbands of Margot's friends are mounted on horses of their own.
Tad and Conrad gallop up to Owen.

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Looks like the three of us will be on a team together.

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: I'm certain Conrad will carry us... Probably grew up with a mallet, didn't you?

nodes.speaker: Conrad
nodes.text: No stranger to the game, sir.
Tad turns to Owen.

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: As for `you...` The purpose of this out-of-your-class game is to...
nodes.text_bbcode: As for [color=#e23b3b][i]you...[/i][/color] The purpose of this out-of-your-class game is to...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Oh, I'm quite familiar with polo, sir.

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: You are?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Sure.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Great pep talk.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You're going to be fine. Maybe we didn't prepare as much as we could have, but we `did` prepare.
nodes.text_bbcode: You're going to be fine. Maybe we didn't prepare as much as we could have, but we [color=#3b78e2][i]did[/i][/color] prepare.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: After all, now you know all about yachts, polo, and how to make wealthy people laugh when it counts.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah, but what happens when we get into territory I'm unfamiliar with?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I haven't exactly thought up any caviar knock-knock jokes.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Wow. The more time I spend with you the more I'm convinced you're just a huge baby.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: `Or` I could catch the next yacht home.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Or[/i][/color] I could catch the next yacht home.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Relax. Geez. If you get too far out of your element, I'll back you up.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: So, seriously, `stop` worrying.
nodes.text_bbcode: So, seriously, [color=#3b78e2][i]stop[/i][/color] worrying.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Okay. Yeah... That actually turned into kind of a great pep talk...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It is?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yes! We're trying to make `you` seem like a rich guy in front of the most scrutinizing, critical people ever!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yes! We're trying to make [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] seem like a rich guy in front of the most scrutinizing, critical people ever!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It's like putting emeralds on an old, torn-up shoe!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I could do without the metaphors.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm just saying... It's totally a reason to be nervous!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I got it!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Sure, Mother. Whatever you want.
As soon as they're out of earshot...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ohmygosh! Urrrrrrg! How could my mother possibly want to marry that guy?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You say unironically from the starboard side of his `yacht...`
nodes.text_bbcode: You say unironically from the starboard side of his [color=#e23b3b][i]yacht...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah, he's crazy rich. This is going to be `the worst` weekend! There's no way I can keep up this good daughter schtick for two days!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, yeah, he's crazy rich. This is going to be [color=#3b78e2][i]the worst[/i][/color] weekend! There's no way I can keep up this good daughter schtick for two days!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: How do you think `I` feel? I'm still trying to understand what makes an off-shore account so desirable...
nodes.text_bbcode: How do you think [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] feel? I'm still trying to understand what makes an off-shore account so desirable...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Does proximity to water make money more valuable?
The yacht pulls into a small harbor cove...
A moment later, Owen and Paige step off the boat, an expansive, verdant estate before them.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Wow.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Be cool. Remember, this is `normal` for you...
nodes.text_bbcode: Be cool. Remember, this is [color=#3b78e2][i]normal[/i][/color] for you...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Right. Normal. Nothing unusual about stepping off a super yacht right into fairy tale land.
A young, smartly dressed man steps out of a nearby towncar to greet them.

nodes.speaker: Conrad
nodes.text: Where is she? Where's my Paige?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: `'My'` Paige?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]'My'[/i][/color] Paige?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Relax, Agent Jealousy. Conrad's just an old family friend.
She turns back to Conrad.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm right here, Conrad, dear. And can I add, you're looking sharper than ever?!

nodes.speaker: Conrad
nodes.text: Not nearly as lovely as you. But then again, I could never compete with your beauty.
Conrad turns his attention to Owen.

nodes.speaker: Conrad
nodes.text: And this must be your...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: If you say 'butler...'

nodes.speaker: Conrad
nodes.text: I was going to say 'boyfriend', but maybe the relationship is more complicated than I thought.

nodes.speaker: Conrad
nodes.text: Ever since Paige told me about you, I've been dying to meet you.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Oh, sorry, man. I'm Owen.

nodes.speaker: Conrad
nodes.text: 'Man'? Interesting vernacular on this one, Paige.
Conrad shakes Owen's hand.

nodes.speaker: Conrad
nodes.text: A pleasure. I'm Conrad. Listen, I have to greet some of the other guests, but I would be delighted to get to know you later.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh, sure.
Conrad leaves, striking up a conversation with Margot and Tad.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What's the matter with you?! We've been here three seconds, and you practically blew your cover with Conrad.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Maybe if you had swallowed your pride and apologized sooner, we could have prepared more!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: For example, I might actually know who Conrad is!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh, yeah, because you referring to yourself as my 'butler' was due to lack of preparation!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm nervous, okay?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, that's...

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Yes. Yes. It `is` very thoughtful of me. Very well. Best behavior. We'll be disembarking soon!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yes. Yes. It [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] very thoughtful of me. Very well. Best behavior. We'll be disembarking soon!

nodes.text: Tad's chest puffs up as he saunters away, Margot in tow.

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Thank you, dear.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: What are you implying? There's nothing underhanded about me socializing with Margot's friends.

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: I'm sure she didn't mean anything by it, Taddy!

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: You didn't mean anything, did you, Paige?

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: You just meant that he's being considerate. `Right?`
nodes.text_bbcode: You just meant that he's being considerate. [color=#3b78e2][i]Right?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Because I know you're brand new to this whole talking thing, but we've got `a lot` of ground to cover!
nodes.text_bbcode: Because I know you're brand new to this whole talking thing, but we've got [color=#3b78e2][i]a lot[/i][/color] of ground to cover!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I've convinced Tad and my mother that you're wealthy enough to belong at their exclusive wedding...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: We need to make sure you're up to speed on all matters money!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Don't worry, I've got it covered. Yachts are for yachting, horses are for polo, and the little fork is for picking at your teeth.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Owen! That's not funny!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh-huh. I just don't understand why me pretending to be wealthy matters, Paige. You know I'm not rich, and you're still with me.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So who cares if your friends and family know I'm not rich too?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: No one! What's at stake this weekend isn't just your reputation... Who cares about that?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: `I` care.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] care.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Whatev. In case you don't remember, Tad and my mother don't like you.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And as long as they suspect you're a low-class, good-for-nothing, dirty...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm not taking any offense to this, by the way.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: The point is... They'll `continue` not to like you.
nodes.text_bbcode: The point is... They'll [color=#3b78e2][i]continue[/i][/color] not to like you.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And the last thing they did to keep us apart was to send me to Monarch Prep.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So you're saying...?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah, our `relationship` is at stake.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, our [color=#3b78e2][i]relationship[/i][/color] is at stake.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Okay then... Maybe I could use a little refresher.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You think?

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: You two! I believe its time we had a chat!
Tad and Margot approach as the yacht begins to slow, nearing its destination. Paige whispers under her breath...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I can't believe my mother begged me to be nice to him this weekend.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, what's not to like?

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Paige, I trust you've got your `friend` in line...
nodes.text_bbcode: Paige, I trust you've got your [color=#e23b3b][i]friend[/i][/color] in line...

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Margot and I are expecting some very important people for the wedding. People much more important than him.

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Tad's excited to meet with some of our friends, Paige. Isn't that sweet of him?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Sweet isn't the word I'd use.

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Ahem.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I meant, uh, taking the time to engage with our friends is very...

nodes.prompt: Taking the time to engage with our friends is very...

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Taking the time to engage with our friends is very...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I made you think you were going to a dinner...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That would have lasted two hours at most.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: ...When really you were going to this wedding...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Which will last for two `days.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Which will last for two [color=#e23b3b][i]days.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And that's a problem because you `are` poor. And my friends and family are...
nodes.text_bbcode: And that's a problem because you [color=#3b78e2][i]are[/i][/color] poor. And my friends and family are...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: ...Obnoxiously rich. Emphasis on 'noxious'.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: So... You're talking to me now?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah. Good apology.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Finally.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That was worse than 'I feel kind of bad'.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I know! But can't we just pretend that I got the apology right?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So, you told me we were going to a two-hour dinner...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Which turned out to be a two-`day` wedding...
nodes.text_bbcode: Which turned out to be a two-[color=#e23b3b][i]day[/i][/color] wedding...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Where I'm supposed to pretend to be rich...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: And you want me to just `pretend` you apologized?
nodes.text_bbcode: And you want me to just [color=#e23b3b][i]pretend[/i][/color] you apologized?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Pretty much! And fast too!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: There's no way you'd be this rude without a reason, so we'll move on for now.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: But none of this pretend crap. You still owe me a real apology.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah, whatever. Are you talking to me now?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I guess so.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Okay, fine... What?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I don't know! I'm... I'm something close to sorry!
Tad stands there, wide-eyed.

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: That was quite impressive!

nodes.text: If she could, I believe she'd say how happy she is to be here today.
Paige sits down as the audience murmurs.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: As for me, I don't know Tad and Margot very well. At all.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: But what I do know is that they are the perfect blend of...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Of strong wealth...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: And public prestige...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: And perfect blends create perfect marriages...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: To Tad and Margot.
The audience of society ladies claps their hands delicately, giving their reserved approval.

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Short! But well spoken!
Tad smiles and nods at Owen. Then he sets his sights on Paige...
As the guests retire to their rooms for the night, Tad manages to corner Paige.

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: You're lucky your boyfriend was there to save us from complete humiliation tonight!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `Us?` Earth to Tad. There `is` no us!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Us?[/i][/color] Earth to Tad. There [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] no us!

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Maybe not now. But tomorrow, when your mother and I are married, there will be.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Okay, no. There won't. So, get out of my face or tell me what you want.

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: I want you to know that your transgressions tonight will not go unpunished!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, sorry to burst your ugly bubble, but you don't have control over--

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Oh, but I do! Tomorrow, I will be your father.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ew.

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: And your mother will do whatever I ask of her.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, you already sent me to Monarch Prep `prison,` and I conquered that, so sorry. Your threats aren't really threatening.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, you already sent me to Monarch Prep [color=#3b78e2][i]prison,[/i][/color] and I conquered that, so sorry. Your threats aren't really threatening.

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: You're quite right!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I am?

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: The strict qualities of Monarch Prep simply cannot be found anywhere else in this country.

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Believe me, I've checked.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: So, I win.

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: But then I checked `outside` this country...
nodes.text_bbcode: But then I checked [color=#e23b3b][i]outside[/i][/color] this country...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh no...

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Oh yes. They're doing wonderful things in Europe these days. Boarding schools that make Monarch Prep look like a theme park.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: But... My friends... Owen...

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Good riddance to them all!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: How can you be so heartless?!

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Did I not tell you I had threats?

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: You didn't do what I asked, and now your mother's even more concerned about the relationship you and I have!

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Face it. You'll be going to the school `I` choose for you. Good night.
nodes.text_bbcode: Face it. You'll be going to the school [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] choose for you. Good night.

nodes.text: Tad walks away just as Owen reaches her.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hey, what did Tad want?
He sees her face...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You okay?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: No, I am way far from okay!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What did he tell you?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: He's going to send me away... Out of the country.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What?! That son of a--
Owen starts to march after Tad, but Paige stops him.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Listen! This wedding can't happen, Owen. Do you understand? It can't!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: But it's happening tomorrow, Paige. It's too late to--

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: --It's not happening tomorrow. It's not happening `ever.`
nodes.text_bbcode: --It's not happening tomorrow. It's not happening [color=#3b78e2][i]ever.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Because I'm going to stop it!

nodes.speaker: Tad

nodes.text: Let me try again! The sun was in my eyes or something!

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Oh no! You've had your turn!
Owen aims the gun at a point in the sky...
Tad steps forward and tries to pry it from his hand!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What are you doing?!

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: I `said` you're done!
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#e23b3b][i]said[/i][/color] you're done!

nodes.speaker: Conrad
nodes.text: This isn't safe! One of you's going to get hurt!
Owen and Tad wrestle until suddenly Owen lets go! Tad lurches back and steps off the edge of the pit! There's a crash like a thousand plates breaking!
Owen and Conrad peer down into the pit... Tad is lying on a crate of shattered clay pigeons.

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: You... You did this on purpose!
Owen hangs his head...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I don't think this is going to end well...

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: You'll never date Paige again! She can't spend time with someone as dangerous as you!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: But, Tad...

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Begone from my sight, you miscreant!
Owen slowly trudges away, knowing for certain that...
Score Up!

nodes.text: Like I said, I'm no stranger to the clay shooting place.
In the distance, a bell rings out the sound for dinner.

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Let's settle up the bill, shall we?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Bill?

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: You didn't think all this equipment was free, did you?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well...

nodes.speaker: Conrad
nodes.text: Actually, Tad, I'll pay for this one. It's the least I can do for such an impressive demonstration of skill.

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Very gentlemanly of you!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah, thanks, Conrad.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Again...

nodes.text: So, Conrad, where `is` your father this weekend?

nodes.text: Oh, he's vacationing in Colorado...

nodes.speaker: Conrad
nodes.text: I see...

nodes.text: Oh, I didn't say anything.

nodes.speaker: Owen

Owen slides in next to Paige.

nodes.text: Paige! I've got to tell you something now!

nodes.speaker: Owen

nodes.speaker: Owen

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: ...You knew?

nodes.text: My mother almost admitted as much earlier, but what can I do about it?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Like it or not, I'm supposed to get along--

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Paige. Come with me.
Tad pulls Paige aside. He reaches into his coat pocket and pulls out a letter, giving it to her.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: A letter? When are we? 1990?

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: When we go back to the table, you're going to stand up and read this in front of everyone.
She opens the letter, scanning it.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Or not! This speech is a declaration of how awesome I think you are!

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: You `will` read it, young lady! I `know` your mother ordered you to be on good behavior in front of me and her friends!

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: I believe she has prepared a speech. And quite frankly, I'm delighted to hear what she has to say.
Paige's mother gives her a pleading look. Paige stands up, the letter shaking in her hand.
She stares at it and begins to read, her voice cracking...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: 'My dear distinguished guests... I am happy you all made it today, this very special day.'

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Bad writing...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ahem. 'I wanted to say that...'
Paige stops unable to read anything complimentary of Tad!
But standing up there alone, she doesn't know what to do!
The society ladies begin to murmur with confusion and displeasure.
In a panic, she silently pleads to Owen!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Help!
Owen stands abruptly.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Surprise! I'll be taking over this speech! Apparently!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Er... What Paige is trying to say is...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: How was that?
Tad stands there, open-mouthed.

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: I'm... I'm completely flummoxed! That was one of the best displays of marksmanship I've ever seen!
`CLICK!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]CLICK![/b]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Whoops! I should have reloaded!
Owen watches as the disc falls to the ground.
He reloads, snaps the gun back into place, aims, and...
`BOOM!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]BOOM![/b]

nodes.text: The air is filled with red dust!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Nailed it!
He hits the low one!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Bam! Deal with that!
Then he quickly...
He hits the high one, but doesn't have time to reload `and` shoot the low one...
nodes.text_bbcode: He hits the high one, but doesn't have time to reload [b]and[/b] shoot the low one...

nodes.text: It lands unbroken.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Probably should have shot the low one first...
Two discs fly into the air at the same time, one very high and one low. Owen aims for the...

Owen quickly reloads, snaps the gun back into place, and fires at the disc, shooting it just before it hits the ground!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Phew!
A disc pops up on the right, high into the air!
Owen fires, but the disc falls to the ground untouched!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Crap!
The gun roars, the disc bursting apart!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Got it!
Owen fires, but the disc falls to the ground untouched!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Crap!
Another disc pops up in the middle!
Owen shoots it out of the sky!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Eat it, fake clay bird!
Owen fires and misses!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Come on! I can do better than this!

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Oh, I'm sure of that. I know beginner's luck when I see it!
The disc is at his focus point!
Owen fires, but the disc remains untouched!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I missed again!
Owen fires!
The disc bursts into a cloud of reddish powder!

nodes.speaker: Conrad
nodes.text: Huh ho!

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Great shot...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It was nothing.
It's just above his focus point!
The shot rings out, but the disc keeps falling!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I can still hit it!
Owen stays patient, watching the disc fall!
Hesitating for a second, Owen panics and fires!
The shot rings out, but the disc keeps falling!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I can still hit it!
A clay disc pops into view to Owen's right. He aims for it and squeezes the trigger!
`CLICK!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]CLICK![/b]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I forgot to load the gun!
The disc drops into the grass, untouched.

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Ha! Forget something?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh... No. I didn't forget anything.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: As a matter of fact, it's a, um, tradition where I come from to fire at the target first `before` loading the gun.
nodes.text_bbcode: As a matter of fact, it's a, um, tradition where I come from to fire at the target first [color=#e23b3b][i]before[/i][/color] loading the gun.

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: That seems rather silly to me...

nodes.speaker: Conrad
nodes.text: No, I've heard about that too. For safety.
Conrad steps forward with a box of ammo, but drops it before Owen can grab hold, spilling shells everywhere!

nodes.speaker: Conrad
nodes.text: Clumsy me!
Conrad crouches down to pick up the shells and uses the opportunity to whisper to Owen.

nodes.speaker: Conrad
nodes.text: Don't hold the gun against your shoulder. Pick a height and stick to it. Fire `ahead` of the target.
nodes.text_bbcode: Don't hold the gun against your shoulder. Pick a height and stick to it. Fire [color=#e23b3b][i]ahead[/i][/color] of the target.

nodes.text: Conrad hands him the last shell and clears his throat.

nodes.speaker: Conrad
nodes.text: There you are. Sorry about that!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No problem.
Owen loads up the shotgun...

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: It doesn't matter if you have bullets! With your form, you haven't a snowball's chance of hitting anything!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Is that so?
Owen snaps the shotgun in place, finding a sweet spot to hold it just `below` his shoulder.
nodes.text_bbcode: Owen snaps the shotgun in place, finding a sweet spot to hold it just [b]below[/b] his shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: This feels more natural...
Remembering Conrad's advice, he picks a height in the sky, just above the horizon.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Here we go!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: `Pull!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Pull![/i][/color]

nodes.text: He sees the disc pop up just to his left! He rotates, keeping his aim at the same height.
The disc rises above the point in the sky that he's focused on, pauses, and then begins to falls back down!
The disc is far above his focus point!

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Is that supposed to be some kind of joke?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I can tell by your seriousness that it got you on the inside only.

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: I am not amused!

nodes.speaker: Conrad
nodes.text: The word you're looking for is 'Pull'.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah, I, uh, knew that. Thanks.

nodes.text: `Pull!`

nodes.text: The men gather on a grassy hilltop, the sun setting behind them.
A servant stands at the traps in a trench below, prepared to release clay targets high into the air...

nodes.speaker: Conrad
nodes.text: I'll go first.
Tad holds Conrad back.

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: One moment. I think Owen should go first. Surely someone who grew up around towncars and polo can hit a target.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh, right. I used to do this all the time in my childhood... Clay... Shooting... Place.

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Then let's see it. Impress me.
Owen steps forward, holding the unfamiliar shotgun in his hands. He places it against his shoulder, sets himself, and calls out...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Tad seems tense for some reason...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: If this were a football game, and he were Spencer, I'd tell a funny story to lighten the mood...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Oh, man, I'm really going to do this!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Ahem.

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Yes?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So... I've got a funny story for you.

nodes.speaker: Conrad
nodes.text: This ought to be interesting...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: The other day, I was riding in my...

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Now, now, ladies... Let's give my daughter a breather.

nodes.speaker: Rich Lady
nodes.text: Yes, of course. Here we are, prattling on about Paige's boyfriend, when really we should be asking `you` the questions!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yes, of course. Here we are, prattling on about Paige's boyfriend, when really we should be asking [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] the questions!

nodes.speaker: Rich Lady
nodes.text: That's right indeed!

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Um, that isn't what I meant!

nodes.speaker: Rich Lady
nodes.text: When I found out you were re-marrying, Margot, I was willing to overlook the scandal of it!

nodes.speaker: Rich Lady
nodes.text: But then I found out it was to Tad Montgomery!

nodes.speaker: Rich Lady
nodes.text: Tssk!

nodes.speaker: Rich Lady
nodes.text: I `hoped` he wasn't a part of the same Montgomeries who think that simply by having money they immediately deserve a place at the high society table.
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]hoped[/i][/color] he wasn't a part of the same Montgomeries who think that simply by having money they immediately deserve a place at the high society table.

nodes.speaker: Rich Lady
nodes.text: Unfortunately, I was wrong.

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: My dears, he's not like that at all. His family, perhaps, I'll grant you. But Tad is...

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: How do I put this? He's smart.

nodes.speaker: Rich Lady
nodes.text: How so?

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Well, I've got a perfect example...

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: I never would have sent Paige back to preparatory school without his influence, but the results, as you can see, are quite stunning.
The ladies look at Paige and nod their approval. Paige tries to hold back her anger.

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Someone as smart as Tad knows it'll take time for him to become a part of us.

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: My only concern is how Tad gets along with Paige. I've asked both of them to be on their best behavior toward one another...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Which is the worst thing you could ever do `ever.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Which is the worst thing you could ever do [color=#3b78e2][i]ever.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Rich Lady
nodes.text: Well, this all comes as a relief. We thought perhaps you and he had some kind of illicit `deal.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, this all comes as a relief. We thought perhaps you and he had some kind of illicit [color=#3b78e2][i]deal.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Rich Lady
nodes.text: You know, you gain his wealth, while he gains access to your social prestige.

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: That's preposterous!
But Paige's mother averts her eyes, alerting Paige...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Do they have a deal?

nodes.speaker: Rich Lady
nodes.text: Does this mean you're marrying him for love?! My word, how modern!
Margot nods...
...But Paige suspects that it's a lie...
Tad steps forward, calling out to the unseen servant down below.

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Anders, prepare for professional trap!

nodes.speaker: Anders
nodes.text: Anything you say, sir.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Professional trap?

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: I'm sure `where you come from` you call it by some absurd name!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm sure [color=#e23b3b][i]where you come from[/i][/color] you call it by some absurd name!

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: But `here,` professional trap means five discs, from any of the five traps, in rapid succession!
nodes.text_bbcode: But [color=#e23b3b][i]here,[/i][/color] professional trap means five discs, from any of the five traps, in rapid succession!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh... You mean... Fivesie flurry?

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Grr! Get ready!
Owen looks to Conrad, who shakes his head subtly, unable to offer any advice.
Tad smiles ruefully as Owen loads up his gun and gets into position...

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Good luck!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I just have to remember to reload after every two shots!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: `PULL!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]PULL![/i][/color]

nodes.text: A disc pops up on the far left!
After the match, the handlers of the grounds help Owen, Conrad, and Tad off of their horses.
Tad pulls out a credit card and hands it to his handler.

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: I'm feeling generous! Add a 4% tip for yourself!
Conrad pulls out a money clip bulging with cash. The bills seem to all be hundreds. He pulls out several bills and hands them over.
Owen catches a look from his handler.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I only have like twenty dollars in my pocket! That's probably not nearly enough to pay for all this!

options.label: Give the handler the twenty dollars.

nodes.text: Huh ho!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Just because I gave that guy a twenty?

nodes.speaker: Conrad
nodes.text: No, it's not that. Although, a twenty is a bit of a giveaway...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Then what?

nodes.speaker: Conrad
nodes.text: You offered to pay me back. You made a big deal out of what `should` be a small amount of money to you.
nodes.text_bbcode: You offered to pay me back. You made a big deal out of what [color=#e23b3b][i]should[/i][/color] be a small amount of money to you.

nodes.text: Owen tries to hold back what he's feeling, but he can't...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Three hundred dollars is `not` a small amount of money!
nodes.text_bbcode: Three hundred dollars is [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] a small amount of money!

nodes.speaker: Conrad
nodes.text: It's not... To `you.`
nodes.text_bbcode: It's not... To [color=#e23b3b][i]you.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Okay, fine. You caught me. I'm not a wealthy guy.

nodes.speaker: Conrad
nodes.text: I don't understand. Why are you pretending to be one?
Owen sighs...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Paige and I are trying to convince Tad and Margot that I'm good enough to date Paige.

nodes.speaker: Conrad
nodes.text: And what about just being a good guy who doesn't have a fortune...?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That's how Paige got transferred to a new school in the first place. Tad's kind of a...

nodes.speaker: Conrad
nodes.text: Pompous airbag?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah. Nice phrase. Can I borrow that?

nodes.speaker: Conrad
nodes.text: Look, you've nothing to worry about. I think you've got him fooled, and your secret's safe with me.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Conrad
nodes.text: Truly. That said, maybe you should consider Margot and Tad's perspective...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Conrad
nodes.text: I've known Paige for a long, long time. She expects a certain level of luxury. Can you really provide that for her?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm... I'm kind of hoping that won't be an issue.

nodes.speaker: Conrad
nodes.text: It will. What happens when you can't pay for something, and I'm not around to help?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I don't know...

nodes.speaker: Conrad
nodes.text: What happens when Paige is there to witness it?

nodes.speaker: Conrad
nodes.text: Sorry to be so bleak. But you should know what you're getting into.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah...
Owen quickly changes topics...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Speaking of food, it looks like I lasted to the rehearsal dinner.

nodes.speaker: Conrad
nodes.text: I wouldn't be so sure of that...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What do you mean?
Conrad nods in the direction of Tad and the men, who are approaching with shotguns held on their shoulders.

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: It's time for clay shooting, boys!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What about the rehearsal?

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: It's only five o'clock! The rehearsal isn't till six! Come along!
Owen can feel his heart racing.

nodes.speaker: Conrad
nodes.text: Psst! Know anything about clay shooting?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No. I'm guessing from the guns that it doesn't have anything to do with sculpting...
The men head off for the clay shooting range, Owen and Conrad trailing behind them.
Meanwhile...
Inside the estate, the society ladies have sat down for tea. Paige is wearing an elegant, lace sundress.

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: I don't know about the rest of you, but personally I loathed my masseuse today.

nodes.speaker: Rich Lady
nodes.text: Whatever was the matter?

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Her hands were far too rough. Not surprising. I could tell as soon as I saw her... She looked like a farmer's daughter.

nodes.speaker: Rich Lady
nodes.text: Tssk! How unfortunate!

nodes.speaker: Rich Lady
nodes.text: Hopefully, you won't let it ruin your day, Margot.
A servant steps into the room and begins setting down ornate pots of steaming, fruit-flavored teas.
One of the ladies turns to Paige...

nodes.speaker: Rich Lady
nodes.text: I meant to ask, Paige, who is that young man I saw with you? He seemed... Peculiar.

nodes.speaker: Rich Lady
nodes.text: I thought so too.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Really? How so?

nodes.speaker: Rich Lady
nodes.text: How did you two meet?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: We met...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I told you! I forgot my money.

nodes.speaker: Conrad
nodes.text: But that's not what you said. You said you 'forgot your money thingie.' It's called a money clip.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So I forgot the word. Big deal.

nodes.speaker: Conrad
nodes.text: If you had one, you'd know what it was called.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Is that all you're basing this on? Terminology?

nodes.speaker: Conrad
nodes.text: No, actually, I'm not basing this on language at all. You brought that up.

nodes.subtitle: Can Owen and Paige fool high society?

nodes.text: You are now playing as Paige.
In the morning, in the cabin of a yacht bound for a remote coastal estate, Paige sits down next to Owen.

nodes.text: Ugh. Look at them.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: We're not like that. We actually `talk.`

nodes.text: Okay, okay. Sometimes, we yell... But still, we say what's on our minds.
Owen turns slightly away from Paige.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: We say it out loud. To our girlfriend. Who feels `really` bad about springing this trip on her 'maybe not as poor as she insinuates' boyfriend.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Come on! The silent treatment?! What are you, seven years old?!
Owen turns back slightly, glaring at her.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Bad time to insult you, I get it. At least stop being dumb and tell me what you want from me!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I already told you. I want an apology.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And I `said` I feel kind of bad for deceiving you.
nodes.text_bbcode: And I [color=#3b78e2][i]said[/i][/color] I feel kind of bad for deceiving you.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That's so far from being an apology it's like an anti-apology. What you just said and an apology would be arch-enemies in a movie.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Fine, you want a real apology? I'll give you an apology!
Paige takes a deep breath.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: This isn't easy for me, you know?
Owen nods.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Okay. Fine...
